analysis: The three quotes are not like-for-like: E-03 is an adjust/repair scope (plunger handle), E-01 is a full waste-and-overflow replacement, and E-02 is a lever/diverter replacement including labor and materials. The amounts are on file with the owner and are not published here (F-02). For context only, published third-party guides put tub drain work at roughly $200–$1,025 depending on access difficulty and drywall patching at roughly $300–$930 on top of the plumbing work (HomeGuide/Angi, linked below — third-party figures, not official sources). None of the three quotes is recorded as including drywall opening or ceiling restoration, so the brief's all-in-one requirement (R-07) has budget relevance: a below-floor access job will likely add a ceiling opening + patch beyond any quote received so far.
